question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing right winger, Bob is playing sweeper, Claire is playing fullback, Dave is playing cheerleader, Eve is playing goalkeeper, Fred is playing right midfielder, and Gertrude is playing striker.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Fred and Claire trade positions. Then, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Fred trade positions. Finally, Dave and Eve trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) right winger
(B) sweeper
(C) fullback
(D) cheerleader
(E) goalkeeper
(F) right midfielder
(G) striker
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: right winger, sweeper, fullback, cheerleader, goalkeeper, right midfielder, striker
1. Dave ↔ Claire: right winger, sweeper, cheerleader, fullback, goalkeeper, right midfielder, striker
2. Fred ↔ Claire: right winger, sweeper, right midfielder, fullback, goalkeeper, cheerleader, striker
3. Dave ↔ Gertrude: right winger, sweeper, right midfielder, striker, goalkeeper, cheerleader, fullback
4. Gertrude ↔ Dave: right winger, sweeper, right midfielder, fullback, goalkeeper, cheerleader, striker
5. Bob ↔ Claire: right winger, right midfielder, sweeper, fullback, goalkeeper, cheerleader, striker
6. Claire ↔ Fred: right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader, fullback, goalkeeper, sweeper, striker
7. Dave ↔ Eve: right winger, right midfielder, cheerleader, goalkeeper, fullback, sweeper, striker
Alice plays right winger, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
